prompts.name: 星河琉璃
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium collectible cosmetic art-direction board for the Chinese cozy night-market cooking game 灯火大排档. Preview-only concept art, not a UI screen or production sprite.
Input image 1: REFERENCE for the game's rounded 2.5D illustration quality, the young chef's exact friendly identity and proportions, front-facing stall composition, and prop placement. Design a new coherent rare skin from background down to serving plate, as described below. The referenced red-striped awning and red plastic stools are not design constraints.
Format: ONE beautiful landscape 4:3 board, roughly2048x1536. Upper approximately75% is one LARGE complete hero scene, with its fully designed environment. Lower approximately25% is a clean warm-ivory material/detail strip with FOUR generous evenly spaced illustrated object studies. Give hero and details breathing room. A small tasteful theme title is allowed above; no giant lettering over the scene. No UI, buttons, prices, rarity stars, charts, unlock conditions or phone hardware.
Hero composition: a compact front-facing food stall with full roof, both hanging lamps, warm wood columns/counter, chef behind counter, black cooking wok with delicious colorful food, serving plate with food at counter left, complete left prep rack with bamboo steamer, tomato and green vegetables, small counter menu at right, plant bottom right and two complete stools bottom left. Keep chef's smiling face, cream toque and cream shirt recognizably the SAME person as reference. Change his apron/straps to the new theme. His hat/face must not overlap the sign or roof. No extra people or pets. Keep the scene readable and inviting at phone scale. Preserve warm natural food colors, healthy green foliage, and a dark usable wok bowl.
A fixed readable wooden shop sign says exactly “家常现炒”. The sign may have modest themed edging, but retain warm wood and dark brown Chinese lettering.
All nine cosmetic groups must be coordinated: environment, awning/roof, two lamps, stool/furnishings, plant pot/ornament, menu stand, serving plate, wok decoration/handle, chef apron. Also design a matching TABLECLOTH in the lower furnishing study; do not add an oversized dining table in front of the hero stall just to display cloth.
Rarity should be expressed through thoughtful silhouette, craft materials and restrained patterns. Motifs should occupy small deliberate zones, not blanket every surface. Render warm tactile wood, fabric, ceramic and metal with soft directional light, clear high-quality edges, subtle shadows and friendly rounded volumes. The two lamps match each other, the two stools match each other, and the detail studies must be the EXACT SAME designs as in the hero, not unrelated variants.
Bottom detail strip: study1 a full complete lantern at generous readable scale; study2 a clean empty serving plate viewed at an angle that clearly shows its shape, glaze and rim motif; study3 a complete stool with a small cloth-covered tabletop-corner study alongside (cloth folds over and covers the front edge, no empty gap); study4 the theme menu stand and black wok with visible custom handle. Tiny Chinese captions as specified below. Full object edges, lamp tassels, stool legs and plate contours fit within the strip.
Avoid: current red/cream striped awning copied unchanged, plain hue-shift of reference, same river market background unchanged, overly busy ornamentation, RGB glow, sci-fi holograms, neon storefronts, cool white fluorescent lights, photorealistic oily food, angular business-app graphics, gaudy jeweled furniture, extra scene insets that compete with the hero, giant tabletop in the foreground, cut-off stool feet or lantern tassels. Keep a refined warm Chinese night-market mood even for the cool palette.

THEME 1: “星河琉璃”
Art direction: indigo night sky, soft peacock-jade glazed ceramic, warm ivory and a little antique brass. A luminous crafted celestial-night-market theme, elegant Chinese folk fantasy. Warm amber lamps and cooking steam preserve the cozy food-stall atmosphere.
Environment: a NEW mountain-town night market on an elevated stone terrace under a clear starry indigo sky, distant layered tiled rooftops and a softly blurred lit bridge/stream far behind, a few warm hanging lights. Composition and location visibly differ from the reference river market. Small stars and a faint cloudlike Milky Way far away; no enormous foreground planets.
Roof: replace the fabric-striped awning with a gentle traditional CURVED EAVE built from blue-jade glazed overlapping tiles, softly raised ends, indigo fascia, thin antique-brass edge and sparse fine constellation inlays. Keep its overall footprint compatible with a small stall. The roof has a distinctive crafted silhouette, not a giant palace. Tiny warm lights may nest beneath eave.
Lanterns: two elegant small OCTAGONAL Chinese palace lanterns with jade-blue translucent glass facets, slim antique-brass ribs and warm-ivory diffusers. Restrained tiny four-point-star openings and a slim indigo tassel. The lantern body is softly rounded and appealing, clearly a Chinese lantern rather than a sci-fi lamp. Do not use an oversized star graphic across its whole surface.
Counter/columns: rich warm honey-walnut wood, small dark-blue inset trim with a few brass star studs. Preserve believable warm wood, no all-metal counter.
Chef: cream shirt/hat, indigo woven apron, ivory straps and one small stitched four-point-star pocket badge, little brass fasteners. No costume armor or crown.
Stools: two compact round warm-walnut stools with four complete short legs and an ivory/jade glazed seat ring, a single small star inlay per stool; generous negative space between legs. Distinct from red plastic stools but still rustic and practical.
Cloth: deep indigo woven linen, ivory fine constellation stitch only at border, slim muted-gold piping. Small natural fold over a wood table corner in the detail study, not a giant hanging banner.
Plate: a refined shallow ivory porcelain dish with a softly scalloped TWELVE-LOBED outline, pale jade/indigo rim and tiny gold star dots joined sparingly by hairline arcs. Center remains clean warm ivory for food readability. Hero plate uses the same scalloped contour and edge design, filled with the original colorful food. Detail2 shows the SAME plate empty, large enough to appreciate its restrained pattern.
Plant pot: blue-jade rounded ceramic with a narrow constellation band, green leaves unchanged.
Menu: indigo lacquer-edged wood tabletop sign, rounded arch top with a small brass star, warm blank cream paper.
Wok: dark seasoned iron bowl, warm wood handle with a short indigo enamel grip and small brass star-shaped end cap. No blue food or bright blue wok bowl.
Detail captions: “琉璃宫灯”, “星纹餐盘”, “桌椅布置”, “菜单与厨具”.
Title text: “星河琉璃”.

THEME 2: “柿灯丰年”
Art direction: ripe persimmon/clay orange, natural oatmeal linen, muted leaf green and honey-chestnut wood. Handcrafted harvest night market, charming and refined. Its silhouettes, textures and environment are completely distinct from a blue celestial theme and from the reference red striped canopy.
Environment: a NEW warm autumn mountain-village night market, a softly blurred terraced stone lane, old timber houses, a ripe persimmon tree with a few glowing-orange fruits over one side, baskets of harvest produce at distant stalls and warm strings of lights. Blue-green dusk sky in distance balances the warm foreground. No reference canal/bridge reused. Props stay soft and secondary to the stall and food.
Roof: a beautifully woven bamboo/reed arched canopy with rounded layered rolled edges, supported by warm bent wood, finished with an oatmeal LINEN SCALLOPED VALANCE and narrow clay-orange bound seams. A small restrained leaf embroidery cluster near each corner. The structure must feel carefully crafted and special, not a ragged straw hut; no alternating red/cream stripes and no modern plastic umbrella.
Lanterns: two plump PERSIMMON-SHAPED warm orange paper lanterns, softly segmented fruit silhouette, muted leaf-green four-lobed cap, small brass stem hook, warm golden inner light and a short burnt-orange knotted tassel. Clearly lanterns, not actual giant tomatoes or jack-o-lantern faces. Match the pair.
Counter/columns: warm chestnut/honey wood, rounded joinery and tiny carved persimmon-leaf accents at panel corners. Retain the original prep/cooking area and all food props.
Chef: cream hat/shirt, oatmeal linen apron with terracotta-orange pocket and one small persimmon-leaf embroidery, leaf-green straps, wooden/brass buttons. Recognizably the same chef and pose.
Stools: two short complete FOUR-LEGGED WARM-WOOD SQUARE STOOLS with softly rounded corners, an oatmeal woven seat pad and restrained clay-orange trim; no plastic red seats. Leg braces connect properly; no floating or missing feet.
Cloth: natural oatmeal woven linen, a thin terracotta double stripe near its edge and a single subtle persimmon-leaf embroidery, tactile hand-sewn hem. Present a small cloth-covered wood-table corner alongside stool study, with cloth draped over tabletop and front rim, no empty gap.
Plate: a shallow CREAM-GLAZED SOFT SQUARE ceramic serving dish whose four rounded corners gently suggest the four sepals of a persimmon calyx; a narrow muted-leaf-green rim and one tiny persimmon stamp near a single corner. Quiet ivory center. It is refined useful tableware, not a novelty giant fruit bowl. Hero food plate has the SAME soft square outline, glaze and small stamp as large empty detail2.
Plant pot: rounded handmade ochre/cream ceramic with a softly scalloped leaf-green lip and a single clay-orange stamped persimmon seal; green foliage unchanged.
Menu: small warm-wood tabletop frame with a subtle four-leaf calyx top detail, oatmeal paper and terracotta edges.
Wok: dark seasoned iron, short rich wooden handle with muted burnt-orange bound grip and a little leaf-shaped brass end loop; cooking surface stays dark and food remains colorful.
Detail captions: “柿子花灯”, “叶边餐盘”, “桌椅布置”, “菜单与厨具”.
Title text: “柿灯丰年”.
